title: Vice City Style Guide: Miami Neon Fashion from GTA to Real Life
lede: The 'vice city style' aesthetic is one of the most searched 80s-Miami looks — neon palette, art deco silhouettes, resort wear with attitude. Here is how to build it in real outfits or AI prompts.
body_md:
## The three anchors of vice city style
**Palette**: hot pink, teal, sunset orange, cream. **Silhouette**: wide shoulder, fitted waist, relaxed trouser. **Attitude**: leisure that looks expensive — resort wear, not beachwear.

## Real-life wardrobe formula
- Tropical print shirt + white wide-leg trousers + loafers
- Slip dress + oversized blazer + strappy heels
- Pastel suit set + gold jewelry + cat-eye sunglasses

## AI prompt version
**vice city style, miami 1980s, neon pink and teal palette, art deco hotel backdrop, golden hour, cinematic, palm trees, 35mm film**
For character work add: 'confident relaxed pose, candid mid-motion' — static poses lose the energy.

## Why this look endures
It is the visual language of游戏的 GTA Vice City / Miami — search interest stays high because it is both nostalgic (80s) and aspirational (luxury leisure). Our GTA6 guide covers the cinematic version; this one is the wearable version.

## Related reading
GTA6 Miami neon guide (cinematic) · Cyberpunk vs Miami (comparison).
faq: Is vice city style the same as GTA6 style?
Related but not identical — vice city is the 80s retro version, GTA6 is the modern-crime-romance version.
